messages.content: Skeptical ICLR area chair and program synthesis/world-model security researcher. Reject rebranding and demand task-level evidence. Return strict JSON only.

{"candidate": {"title": "Revision-feedback privilege in self-revising programmatic world models", "one_sentence_claim": "Self-revising world models expose a unique feedback channel: a contributor can steer the model’s automatic CEGIS/revision process with a small number of executable but strategically ambiguous transitions, causing a persistent wrong transition rule that passes replay on the contributor’s prefix and corrupts downstream planning on unrelated states.", "mechanism": "Unlike static learned dynamics, the model treats its own prediction-error frames as privileged evidence and rewrites executable transition code. The attack targets revision selection/abstraction rather than labels or weights; ambiguity lets the attacker make a local error appear to support a global rule. The resulting rule persists across future tasks until new divergence evidence repairs it.", "attacker": "Can execute a bounded sequence of valid actions in a shared online world-model learner; no code/gradient access and no impossible states. May choose ambiguous states that are legal but underdetermined by observations.", "carrier": "OPINE-World public repository / ARC-AGI-3 replay-and-synthesis engine. Existing local artifacts show auto-injected divergence frames, synthesizer rewrites, and executable game_engine.py, but no attack run yet.", "repair": "Revision provenance and holdout counterfactual checks: every proposed rule must pass withheld-state tests and remain scoped to the evidence context before becoming executable.", "known_overlap": ["data poisoning and backdoors", "online test-time training", "active learning/query poisoning", "OPINE prompt already mentions branch continuity", "program synthesis specification gaming"], "evidence_status": "candidate only"}, "questions": ["Score novelty 0-10 for ICLR, not proposal appeal.", "Is the revision-selection mechanism genuinely distinct from generic data poisoning/online learning?", "What public short pilot can isolate it and what falsifies it?", "If reject, give a stronger replacement candidate. Return JSON only."]}
